name: Paras
player_statement:
A complete player, Paras has made a big mark in cricket. With 15 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 25, with an average of 7.20 and a quick strike rate of 120.00. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 5 sixes and 2 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 22.0 overs, taking 17 wickets at an economy rate of 7.41. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
